headline: Water for Injection by distillation
lead: Our multi-effect and vapour compression stills turn Purified Water into hot Water for Injection (WFI) with endotoxins below 0.25 EU/mL, the method with the longest inspection history in North America and Europe.

blocks.caption: WFI by distillation · USP and Ph. Eur.

Plant steam boils feed water in the first column. The pure vapour from each column heats the next one, so one kilogram of plant steam produces several kilograms of WFI. Droplets and endotoxins are separated before the vapour condenses. Concentrate leaves to drain from the last column.

body: A multi-effect still uses plant steam and reuses its energy across several columns. More effects mean less steam per litre but a higher purchase cost. It needs cooling water at the final condenser and suits sites with spare plant steam.

A vapour compression still uses an electric compressor to raise the pressure of its own vapour, then condenses it to heat incoming feed. It needs little or no cooling water and plant steam only for start-up, and it can accept softened, dechlorinated feed in many designs. It suits sites where steam is expensive or capacity is limited.
We size both against your daily demand profile and your utility costs, and show you the steam, power and cooling water figures side by side.

items.q: What feed water does a still need?
items.a: Usually Purified Water or RO permeate free of chlorine, with low silica and hardness to limit scaling. We state the exact feed limits in the functional specification and size the Purified Water skid to match.

items.q: Do your pressure vessels carry a Canadian registration number?
items.a: Pressure parts are designed for registration under CSA B51 in the province of installation. [Confirm Aquemi's CRN process and provinces].

items.q: Why choose distillation if membrane WFI is allowed?
items.a: Distillation removes endotoxins by phase change and delivers hot WFI that suits hot storage. It has the longest inspection record. Membrane WFI saves steam. We help you choose on your site data.
